landing.headline: Collect every dollar you're owed. Stop losing members quietly.
landing.sub: One app for the front desk, the gym floor and your members' phones. Arabic and English, on the cheapest Android, through a power cut.
landing.guarantee: If it doesn't recover more in missed dues than we charge you in the first 90 days, you don't pay.

dues.title: Who owes you, on the first screen
dues.body: Open it in the morning and you know: who came in, who owes money, whose membership ends this week. One tap opens a WhatsApp message you don't have to write.

proof.title: Proof it's working, not a feeling
proof.body: What share of renewals were paid on time this quarter, and what that share was the quarter before. It is the same number our guarantee is settled on.

lapsed.title: Nobody disappears quietly
lapsed.body: Members who haven't walked in for two weeks, longest gap first. People don't quit a gym — they stop coming, and nobody notices for a month.

floor.title: Your coach taps. Your coach never types.
floor.body: Every set comes pre-filled from last session. Weight and reps are big steppers, not a keyboard. It keeps working with the internet down and sends itself when the internet is back.

member.title: Your members get their own app
member.body: Today's workout, the class calendar, booking, and progress photos that stay private unless the member shares them.

assistant.title: An assistant that answers — and knows when not to
assistant.body: Members ask about food and training in their own words, and it can log a meal they describe. It can never change a program or a calorie target: that becomes a draft their coach approves.

import.title: From the notebook, in half a day
import.body: Hand over the spreadsheet. Arabic names, 03 and +961 numbers, half-filled rows — it reads them, shows you exactly what it found, and corrections go in before anything is saved.

landing.builtTitle: Built for the way gyms here actually run

power.title: Power cuts are normal
power.body: Work queues on the phone and sends itself when the power and the internet come back. A generator kicking in mid-session never loses a logged set.

light.title: Made for cheap Android phones
light.body: The whole app weighs less than one photo from your camera, and the build fails if that ever stops being true. It opens fast on a phone that isn't new.

lang.title: Arabic and English, equally
lang.body: Not a translation bolted on afterwards. Every screen is laid out right-to-left in Arabic and left-to-right in English, and it switches in one tap.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp, not email
whatsapp.body: Reminders go the way Lebanon actually talks. You tap send yourself, so your gym's number never gets reported for blasting.

privacy.title: Private by default
privacy.body: A member's progress photos are theirs. Sharing is one photo at a time, by the member, and deleting really deletes.

landing.waMessage: Hi — I run a gym and I would like to see AIGym.
landing.footerNote: Built in Lebanon, for gyms in Lebanon.

desk.title: The front desk
desk.body: Everything the person on the desk does in a day — take a payment, look up a member, change your prices, add a coach.

floor.title: The floor, on an iPad
floor.body: What your coach holds during a session. Big targets, pre-filled numbers, and it keeps working when the internet doesn't.

phone.title: The member's own phone
phone.body: What your members see. They book, log, and track without anyone at the desk doing it for them.
